description: The module-level doc example in pkix-lint/src/lib.rs (lines 74-99) uses the rust,ignore annotation, which means cargo test --doc does not compile or run it. The example references check_cert() with a 3-parameter signature (cert, kind, now) but the actual trait signature is check_cert(cert, kind, now_unix). Any drift between the doc example and the real API goes undetected. Change to rust,no_run or provide a compilable example with real imports. This applies to several other rust,ignore examples in cabf_tls_br.rs, deviation.rs, and report.rs.
title: pkix-lint doc example in lib.rs uses rust,ignore — example code not compile-tested
